name: Pluck (bass)

beschreibung.text: Tight plucked bass: unison saws through a ladder opened by a short, deep filter envelope, no sustain.

notiz: Source rule: recipe card `bass.pluck`, Snoman [B3] p. 444. Measured by `tests/rezepte.rs`, not yet heard. Dropped as the opposite of an earlier word: thin. Manifest use words outside the vocabulary: groove (as drop).
